{"model": "deepseek-flash", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "你在为一款防剧透阅读器编写“人物表”。读者刚读完《jekyll》的「SEARCH FOR MR. HYDE」。
只能使用下面给出的资料，绝不能写入任何后文情节，即使你知道这部作品。

为每个人物写：
- tagline：一句话身份（≤18字），说清他是谁、现在处于什么位置；
- bio：100～160字的人物小传，写法像书前的人物表：
  第一句交代他是谁（身份、与主要人物的关系）；接着一句概括性格；然后按时间顺序概括至今的人生轨迹，只挑真正改变他处境或关系的大事，每件事一句话；最后一句写目前处境。
要求：用概括性的语言，不要场景细节和琐事（吃什么、穿什么、某个动作）；年龄、身份、住处等用最新的信息；不评价、不预测，不写资料里没有的内容。

【P1｜Mr. Utterson】
别称：Utterson
当前一句话身份：Lawyer, kinsman and friend of Enfield
档案（最新）：occupation：lawyer；personality：blameless past, troubled by old sins；situation：obsessed with finding and seeing Hyde；residence：bachelor house near a church；identity：lawyer of Gaunt Street
关系：Mr. Richard Enfield（cousin）、Dr. Jekyll（old friend）、Dr. Lanyon（friend）
至今经历（按时间）：
- Enfield points his cane at a sinister door and asks Utterson if he ever remarked it.
- Enfield calls the door place Black Mail House and muses.
- Utterson asks the name of the man who walked over the child.
- Utterson says he already knows the other party's name.
- Enfield and Utterson agree never to refer to the matter again.
- Utterson comes home in low spirits and studies Jekyll's will in his business room.
- The will leaves all Jekyll's possessions to Edward Hyde, and Hyde inherits if Jekyll vanishes.
- Utterson calls the will madness and now fears it is disgrace.
- Utterson goes to Cavendish Square to consult his friend Dr. Lanyon.
- Lanyon welcomes Utterson warmly as an old school and college friend.
- Utterson asks whether he and Lanyon are Jekyll's two oldest friends.
- Utterson asks Lanyon about Hyde, and Lanyon has never heard of him.
- Utterson lies awake all night, haunted by Enfield's tale and the faceless figure.
- Utterson keeps watch by the by-street door at all hours until his patience is rewarded.
- Utterson resolves to hunt for Hyde, thinking 'If he be Mr. Hyde, I shall be Mr. Seek.'
- A small plainly dressed man approaches the door with a key, and Utterson accosts him as Mr. Hyde.
- Utterson accosts Hyde and asks to be admitted to see Jekyll.
- Utterson asks to see Hyde's face and studies it.
- Hyde angrily accuses Utterson of lying about Jekyll's description.
- Utterson walks away deeply disturbed by Hyde's appearance.
- Utterson arrives at Jekyll's house and is admitted by Poole.
- Poole tells Utterson that Dr. Jekyll has gone out.
- Poole confirms Hyde has a key and comes by the dissecting room door.
- Poole says all servants have orders to obey Hyde.
- Poole says Hyde never dines there and mostly uses the laboratory.
- Utterson goes home fearing Jekyll is in deep waters.

【P3｜the man in the middle】
别称：Edward Hyde、Hyde、Mr. Hyde、one Hyde、the man
当前一句话身份：Tramples a girl, pays with a cheque
档案（最新）：appearance：husky, whispering, broken voice；personality：merciless, inspires enduring hatred；situation：has a key to Jekyll's house；identity：Jekyll's friend and benefactor；residence：a street in Soho
关系：Dr. Jekyll（the one succeeded）、Poole（servant）
至今经历（按时间）：
- Enfield collars the man and brings him back to the group around the child.
- The man tramples over the girl's body and leaves her screaming.
- The doctor turns sick and white with desire to kill the prisoner.
- They threaten scandal and force the man to pay a hundred pounds.
- The man leads them to the door, unlocks it, and returns with gold and a cheque.
- The man offers to stay until the banks open and cash the cheque himself.
- They spend the night in Enfield's chambers and go to the bank next day.
- The will leaves all Jekyll's possessions to Edward Hyde, and Hyde inherits if Jekyll vanishes.
- Utterson asks Lanyon about Hyde, and Lanyon has never heard of him.
- A small plainly dressed man approaches the door with a key, and Utterson accosts him as Mr. Hyde.
- Utterson accosts Hyde and asks to be admitted to see Jekyll.
- Hyde tells Utterson that Dr. Jekyll is from home.
- Utterson asks to see Hyde's face and studies it.
- Hyde gives Utterson his address in Soho.
- Hyde angrily accuses Utterson of lying about Jekyll's description.
- Hyde snarls, unlocks the door, and disappears into the house.

【P8｜Dr. Lanyon】
别称：Lanyon
当前一句话身份：Utterson's old friend and fellow doctor
档案（最新）：occupation：doctor with a house in Cavendish Square；appearance：hearty, red-faced, prematurely white hair；personality：boisterous, decided, theatrical but genuine
关系：Mr. Utterson（friend）、Dr. Jekyll（friend）
至今经历（按时间）：
- Utterson goes to Cavendish Square to consult his friend Dr. Lanyon.
- Lanyon welcomes Utterson warmly as an old school and college friend.
- Utterson asks whether he and Lanyon are Jekyll's two oldest friends.
- Lanyon says Jekyll became too fanciful and wrong in mind over ten years ago.
- Utterson asks Lanyon about Hyde, and Lanyon has never heard of him.

【P10｜Poole】
别称：无
当前一句话身份：elderly servant at Dr. Jekyll's house
档案（最新）：occupation：servant and butler at Jekyll's house；situation：all servants ordered to obey Hyde
关系：Dr. Jekyll（master）、the man in the middle（obeyed superior）
至今经历（按时间）：
- Utterson arrives at Jekyll's house and is admitted by Poole.
- Poole tells Utterson that Dr. Jekyll has gone out.
- Poole confirms Hyde has a key and comes by the dissecting room door.
- Poole says all servants have orders to obey Hyde.
- Poole says Hyde never dines there and mostly uses the laboratory.

【P7｜Dr. Jekyll】
别称：Harry、Harry Jekyll、Henry Jekyll、Jekyll
当前一句话身份：doctor whose will names Hyde as heir
档案（最新）：identity：Henry Jekyll, M.D., D.C.L., L.L.D., F.R.S.；situation：from home, gone out
关系：Mr. Utterson（old friend）、the man in the middle（successor）、Dr. Lanyon（friend）、Poole（servant）

- The will leaves all Jekyll's possessions to Edward Hyde, and Hyde inherits if Jekyll vanishes.
- Utterson asks whether he and Lanyon are Jekyll's two oldest friends.
- Lanyon says Jekyll became too fanciful and wrong in mind over ten years ago.
